# Eruda vendor assets

Bundled from the npm package `eruda@3.4.3` (MIT), without runtime CDN requests.
`eruda.js` is the self-contained browser bundle (including its UI styles and
icons); `eruda-polyfill.js` is the optional upstream compatibility bundle.
Dragon86 loads `eruda.js` on demand from the Developer setting.

Upstream: https://github.com/liriliri/eruda
The original package README is preserved as `UPSTREAM-README.md`.
